summary: Iteration 3 covered the new Construction Contract feature end-to-end. Backend pytest expanded from 20 → 36 (all PASS): +3 Settings (GET/PUT company/contractor info + auth), +5 Contract Generate (404 missing, 400 non-Won, 401 no-auth, correct-data with scope/exclusions/schedule/markup/client+contractor info + invoice link, idempotency confirming no duplicates), +5 Contract CRUD (list requires auth, list+get, get 404, partial-update merges only provided fields including markup+signatures+status, delete verified by 404), +3 Contract PDF (auth-required, application/pdf + %PDF header + attachment disposition + filename ends .pdf, 404). Frontend Playwright covered the full user journey: (1) Estimates page shows generate-estimate-{id} on Won rows; clicking creates contract+invoice and navigates to /contracts/:id; (2) contract-detail-page renders all 7 sections and every expected testid (contractor-name, contract-client-name, project-address, contract-total, scope-item-*, add-milestone-btn, add-exclusion-btn, markup-input, client/contractor-signature-pad, mark-signed-btn, save-contract-btn, contract-pdf-btn); (3) scope table lists estimate line items; (4) signature pads accept pointer-based drawing — after drawing, the date fields auto-fill with today's long-date and after Save+full reload both signatures + Signed status + edited markup (27%) persist in backend; (5) Mark-as-Signed shows a Sonner error toast ('Both parties must sign…') when no signatures are present, and only transitions status to Signed when BOTH are present; (6) add-milestone-btn and add-exclusion-btn add rows; markup edit persists; (7) contract-pdf-btn triggers download with filename CON-2026-0001.pdf; (8) Contracts nav (nav-contracts) and contracts-page list and open-contract-{id} work. No regressions on dashboard/clients/estimates/jobs/invoices flows.

minor.issue: Iter-2 action item is FIXED — undeliverable emails now return HTTP 400 with friendly JSON detail ('That client's email address looks undeliverable…') so ingress no longer rewrites the body. Test updated to accept 400.

ContractUpdate treats any None value as 'not provided' (strips before merge). Fine for the current UI, but it means callers cannot explicitly clear a string field (e.g. wipe a signature) by sending null — they must send an empty string. Consider Pydantic model_fields_set-based filtering if needed.

Contract-idempotency key is estimate_id, so if a contract is deleted (DELETE /api/contracts/{id}) but the invoice still exists, a subsequent generate call would create a new contract linked to the same estimate/invoice — probably desirable, just documenting.

design_issues.screen: Contracts list page + Estimates page + Contract detail top bar
issues: Same low-contrast pattern as iter-1/2: dark page headings ('Contracts', 'Back to Contracts' link, and top-right 'Download PDF' outline button) render against the dark teal marble background making text nearly invisible until hovered. Applies to the Contracts list where the 'Contracts' heading is barely readable.
Milestone rows use grid col-span with trailing trash button in col-span-1, but on smaller widths (sm) the trash column can overlap the amount field. Not blocking on desktop.

action_items: Improve contrast of page-level headings + secondary buttons over the dark teal marble background (Contracts list heading is the worst offender this iteration).
Optional: allow PUT /api/contracts/{id} to explicitly clear signature fields (e.g. accept null OR treat empty-string as clear — currently supported via empty string, so this is only a nicety).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 988 lines — split by domain (auth/clients/estimates/contracts/invoices/jobs/settings) before it grows further.

build_contract_from_estimate copies line_items via LineItem(**i) without recomputing amount — this is fine because the estimate has already computed amount, but if a caller ever tweaks unit_price/quantity on the contract copy those won't recalc client-side (the ContractDetail scope table is read-only, so OK).

ContractUpdate merges via {**existing, **updates} in Python then persists via $set only for updates — Contract model_validate is applied to merged dict; safe. But note that nested list fields (payment_schedule, exclusions, line_items) are replaced whole, which is intentional and correct.
next_number still uses count_documents (race-condition prone) — carried over from iter-1/2; low priority for MVP.

SignaturePad canvas initializes only once (empty deps). If the parent Component's initial value arrives after mount (data still loading), the existing-signature image won't be redrawn. In practice the parent waits for the query and only mounts once — verified working — but a `value` dep on the effect would be safer for edit-later flows.
ContractDetail.js is 292 lines — reasonable, but consider extracting the SectionCard, payment-schedule editor, and exclusions editor into their own files.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (+16 tests: Settings x3, ContractGenerate x5, ContractCRUD x5, ContractPDF x3; also updated the iter-2 email undeliverable test to accept the new 400 status)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical contract flows verified (generate → detail → sign → save → reload persist → PDF → list)

test_credentials: Bearer session_token='test_session_verify' (user verify@example.com). Cookie fallback also works. Frontend: inject via localStorage before boot.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. All CRUD tests use TEST_-prefixed data and clean up after themselves. Existing demo contract CON-2026-0001 (Linda Garcia, $26,088) was signed during frontend testing (status is now 'Signed' with real drawn signatures + markup=27). If main agent wants a fresh demo, PUT that contract back to status='Draft' and clear signatures — or leave as-is to demo the Signed state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 36 backend tests pass on the preview URL. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and localStorage session_token. To reproduce the signature-pad test: goto /contracts/:id, page.mouse.down + move on the canvas bounding box (touchAction:none allows pointer events), the onPointerUp handler calls canvas.toDataURL() and pushes it into React state along with today's long-date. Contract PDF endpoint returns a real 2-page reportlab PDF that embeds signature PNGs via base64. Known good contract for smoke tests: CON-2026-0001. Iter-2 email-undeliverable status is now 400 (was 502) — updated backend_test.py accordingly.
rca of the issue: None — no failing user-facing behavior. All checked functionality of the new Construction Contract feature (generate, edit, sign, save, mark-signed, PDF, list) is wired correctly end-to-end. Only pending polish is heading/button contrast on the marble background (iter-1/2/3 recurring).
